purpose: Reviewer-facing ground-interface and close-range urban-design deepening for the three provisional KEY_AREA polygons without asserting statutory dimensions, ownership, FAR, height controls, road redlines or approved engineering conditions.

truth_contract.existing_context: OSM candidate context; not a locked-layer substitute
truth_contract.section_dimensions: diagrammatic visualization proportions only; not road-redline or engineering dimensions

human_stop_contract.name: Human Stop / Human Override
human_stop_contract.principle: A person with defined operational authority can stop, bypass, revert or hand over an AI-assisted service or bounded test without requiring the AI system itself to authorize the stop.
spatial_expression: staffed or clearly assigned human-help point
physical or operational separation from the bounded test
human_stop_contract.not_a_gadget: Human Stop is represented as an operational-spatial contract, not as a decorative emergency button.

review_questions: Can a non-participant move through the area without using AI?
Is there an obvious accessible ordinary route?
Does the ground floor make the area's role legible before any digital overlay?
Are AI/test functions visibly backstage or bounded?
Are shade, seating, blue-green comfort and human help part of the permanent baseline?
Can servicing, emergency access and night operation coexist without dominating public life?

areas.ground_interface_thesis_zh: 把高风险验证从普通城市生活中分层，而不是把整个园区变成试验场。
areas.ground_interface_thesis_en: Layer high-risk validation away from ordinary city life instead of turning the whole campus into a test field.
areas.human_stop_role: Test authority: staffed safety/governance desk can stop the bounded test; ordinary bypass and emergency access remain usable during stop or failure.

edge_types.baseline: 共享门厅、可见人工服务、普通步行界面
edge_types.ai_role: 成果解释与低风险信息辅助

edge_types.baseline: 人工安全台、公告、退出与申诉入口
edge_types.ai_role: 试验记录与状态展示，不替代人工停机

edge_types.baseline: 物理缓冲、普通人旁路、应急入口
edge_types.ai_role: 机器人/低速自治/边缘算力等有界测试

edge_types.baseline: 后勤不穿越主要公共庭院
edge_types.ai_role: 设备维护、能源与算力服务

areas.ordinary_route: 公共门厅 → 林荫共享庭院 → 普通通行旁路 → 人工安全台；全程无需 AI 许可。
areas.accessible_route: 无台阶主路径 + 连续触觉提示 + 人工问询点 + 与测试边界清晰分离。
areas.blue_green: 树荫共享庭院 + 雨水花园带 + 可坐边缘；水务与地下条件仍需专业核验。
areas.operational_separation: Public / Review / Bounded Test / Service 四级边缘逐步后退。

areas.name_zh: AI 原点社区 / Learning Neighborhood
areas.ground_interface_thesis_zh: 先把校社之间做成可坐、可走、可问人的学习街区，再让 AI 作为可选择的服务层出现。
areas.ground_interface_thesis_en: First make the university-community seam walkable, sittable and human-helpful; AI then appears as an optional service layer.
areas.human_stop_role: Service override: staffed public service remains available and can revert personalized/recognition-based assistance to ordinary non-AI service without blocking access.

edge_types.baseline: 开放座席、普通公告、人工活动台
edge_types.ai_role: 课程、机会与活动信息辅助

edge_types.baseline: 人工帮助、无障碍设施、固定公共服务信息
edge_types.ai_role: 多语/无障碍辅助需遵守 Consent 与 Human Override

edge_types.baseline: 步行、自行车、停留有清晰次序
edge_types.ai_role: 低风险环境感知与路径提示

edge_types.baseline: 安静、夜间照明不过度、隐私优先
edge_types.ai_role: 不得默认识别或个性化跟踪

areas.ordinary_route: 社区入口 → 校社学习客厅 → 包容服务庭院 → 慢行门廊；普通标识与人工帮助始终可用。
areas.accessible_route: 最直接的无障碍线与主要公共空间重合，不把残障用户导向后门或独立系统。
areas.blue_green: 可坐树荫庭院 + 透水/雨水花园边缘 + 夏季避热节点；所有设施先按非 AI 条件成立。
areas.operational_separation: Ambient 低风险支持可在公共层出现；个性化、识别性或敏感数据服务进入明确 Consent Layer。
human_scenes: 低视力用户沿触觉主线

areas.ground_interface_thesis_zh: 把交易、骑手、通勤和夜间生活放进同一条可管理的城市首层，而不是用 AI 设施占领街道。
areas.ground_interface_thesis_en: Place trade, riders, commuting and night life in one manageable urban ground floor instead of letting AI equipment occupy the street.
areas.human_stop_role: Operations override: merchants, stewards and site operators can suspend AI dispatch or night-service orchestration while ordinary payment, navigation, loading rules and staffed help continue.

edge_types.baseline: 普通交易、可见门店、人工问询
edge_types.ai_role: 商户服务编排与多语辅助可选

edge_types.baseline: 不占主步行线、明确停靠与等待
edge_types.ai_role: 调度建议不能取消人工管理与现场规则

edge_types.baseline: 照明、座椅、厕所/求助信息、普通导航
edge_types.ai_role: 夜间安全辅助与活动信息，不替代人工安保

edge_types.baseline: 树荫、避雨、儿童/老人停留、慢行连续

areas.ordinary_route: 站城方向 → 市场服务街 → 夜间城市客厅 → 绿地复合庭院；支付、导航与求助均保留非 AI 方式。
areas.accessible_route: 连续平顺主线避开骑手等待与装卸口袋；主要入口、座席和人工服务点在同一可达层。
areas.blue_green: 树池/雨水花园与遮荫座席构成连续微气候带；规划绿地法律属性仍待核验。
areas.operational_separation: 主步行线 / 活跃首层 / 骑手与装卸口袋 / 夜间停留 / 后勤入口分层并可在不同时段切换。
